title: Facade Pattern
overview: Provide a simplified interface to a complex subsystem, reducing the number of dependencies clients need.
useCases: You want to hide the complexity of multiple classes behind a single entry point
You want a simple, unified interface to a complex subsystem
You want to reduce coupling between client code and a complex set of classes
exampleUses: A HomeAutomation facade with a leaveHome() method that internally turns off lights, locks doors, and sets the alarm
An OrderService facade that coordinates inventory reservation, payment processing, and shipping dispatch behind a single placeOrder() call
A compiler facade with a compile(sourceFile) method that hides the lexer, parser, semantic analyser, and code generator from the caller
